heading: Adoption & Community
body: We believe a healthier community starts outside our doors too. Fernwood partners with local shelters and hosts free educational events year-round.

items.text: Monthly pet adoption events with Cedar Falls Animal Rescue
Ongoing partnerships with 3 regional rescue organizations
Free pet education seminars, open to the public
Charity care fund for families facing hardship
